nights.title: Los Van Van
nights.name: Los Van Van
nights.extract: Los Van Van is one of the leading musical groups of post-revolutionary Cuba. It was founded in 1969 by bassist Juan Formell, who directed the band until his death in 2014. Formell and former band members Changuito and Pupy are some of the most important figures in contemporary Cuban music, having contributed to the development of songo and timba, two popular dance music genres.

en.who: Los Van Van is one of the leading musical groups of post-revolutionary Cuba. Its former members Changuito and Pupy are among the most important figures in contemporary Cuban music.
facts: It was founded in 1969 by bassist Juan Formell, who directed the band until his death in 2014.

Formell and former band members Changuito and Pupy are some of the most important figures in contemporary Cuban music, having contributed to the development of songo and timba, two popular dance music genres.

de.who: Los Van Van gehört zu den führenden Musikgruppen des nachrevolutionären Kubas. Ehemalige Mitglieder wie Changuito und Pupy zählen zu den wichtigsten Persönlichkeiten der zeitgenössischen kubanischen Musik.
facts: Gegründet wurde die Band 1969 vom Bassisten Juan Formell, der sie bis zu seinem Tod im Jahr 2014 leitete.

Formell sowie die früheren Bandmitglieder Changuito und Pupy gehören zu den wichtigsten Figuren der zeitgenössischen kubanischen Musik und haben zur Entwicklung von Songo und Timba beigetragen, zwei populären Tanzmusikgenres.

tr.who: Los Van Van, devrim sonrası Küba'nın önde gelen müzik gruplarından biridir. Eski üyeler Changuito ve Pupy, çağdaş Küba müziğinin en önemli isimleri arasındadır.
facts: Grup 1969'da bas gitarist Juan Formell tarafından kuruldu ve Formell 2014'teki ölümüne kadar grubu yönetti.
Formell ile eski üyeler Changuito ve Pupy, çağdaş Küba müziğinin en önemli isimleri arasında yer alıyor; songo ve timba gibi iki popüler dans müziği türünün gelişimine katkıda bulundular.

nights.title: Benny Ibarra
nights.name: Benny Ibarra
nights.extract: Benny Ibarra de Llano is a Mexican singer, musician, producer and actor. He was born into a family of artists. His mother, Julissa, was a singer and actress in the 1960s; and his father, Benny, an actor and 1960s rock singer in the Mexican band Los Yaki. His brother, Alejandro Ibarra, is a singer and actor.

en.kicker: mexican singer, musician, producer and actor
en.who: Benny Ibarra de Llano is a Mexican singer, musician, producer and actor. He was born into a family of artists, and his brother Alejandro Ibarra is also a singer and actor.
facts: His mother, Julissa, was a singer and actress in the 1960s; and his father, Benny, an actor and 1960s rock singer in the Mexican band Los Yaki.
His brother, Alejandro Ibarra, is a singer and actor.

de.kicker: mexikanischer sänger, musiker, produzent und schauspieler
de.who: Benny Ibarra de Llano ist ein mexikanischer Sänger, Musiker, Produzent und Schauspieler. Er stammt aus einer Künstlerfamilie; sein Bruder Alejandro Ibarra ist ebenfalls Sänger und Schauspieler.
facts: Seine Mutter Julissa war in den 1960er-Jahren Sängerin und Schauspielerin, sein Vater Benny in den 1960ern Schauspieler und Rocksänger der mexikanischen Band Los Yaki.
Sein Bruder Alejandro Ibarra ist Sänger und Schauspieler.

tr.kicker: meksikalı şarkıcı, müzisyen, yapımcı ve oyuncu
tr.who: Benny Ibarra de Llano, Meksikalı bir şarkıcı, müzisyen, yapımcı ve oyuncudur. Sanatçılardan oluşan bir aileye doğdu; kardeşi Alejandro Ibarra da şarkıcı ve oyuncudur.
facts: Annesi Julissa 1960'larda şarkıcı ve oyuncuydu; babası Benny ise 1960'larda Meksikalı Los Yaki grubunda rock şarkıcısı ve oyuncuydu.
Kardeşi Alejandro Ibarra da şarkıcı ve oyuncudur.
